tenderSchedule.title: RFP for Selection of Technology Companies for Implementation of Composite Digital Crop Survey (CDCS) Pilot Project in Athani Hobli.
tenderSchedule.description: RFP for Selection of Technology Companies for Implementation of Composite Digital Crop Survey (CDCS) Pilot Project in Athani Hobli.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Project Director, FRUITS Project, FRUITS PMU, Centre for e-Governance Room No. 138, Gate no.2, MS Building, Bengaluru-560001

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1.Experience in implementation of similar projects involving satellite / remote sensing based crop identification and crop mapping, including plot-level crop identification and multi-crop identification. 2.Experience in Remote Sensing/ Satellite/ SAR/ Geospatial Projects in identification of features like Buildings, Non-Agriculture lands or crops 3.Experience in AI/ML-based crop identification/ image classification/ agricultural analytics.

1.The Organization should have a cumulative turnover of at least Rs. 20 Crores during last 2 financial years i.e. 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 or an average of at least Rs 10 crores per annum in the last two years mentioned. 2.If it is a start-up and the registration and time duration from initiation of work itself is less than two years it may have a turnover of Rs. 10.00 Crores per year and should have at least one complete financial years turnover. 3.For a company to qualify for more than one hobli the company shall have additional Rs. 20 Crores during last 2 financial years i.e. 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 or an average of at least Rs. 10 crores per annum in the last two years mentioned for each additional hobli (Total Rs. 40 crores for two hoblis and Rs. 60 Crores for three hoblis). 4.In case of consortiums, the lead bidder shall have these turn over(s).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be a profit making company in each of the last 2 financial years (2024-2025 and 2025-2026).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited Financial Statement of Accounts of the last 2 financial years (2024-2025 and 2025-2026).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder Organization should be registered under the Companies Act and should have been in operation for a period of at least 3 years as of bid submission date.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Commencement of Business issued by the Registrar of Companies

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have involved in any major litigation that may have an impact or compromise the delivery of services as required under this contract in the past two (2) years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- valid document evidences (As per RFP)
